_about: The data access ladder (ROADMAP I16, T1213). One entry per commercial data source: where Carta stands today, the legal route, the number that unlocks the next step and the flag that would switch the code path on. Thresholds are edited here, not in code. Every flag is off until the owner sets its environment variable to 1; nothing in this file switches anything live. docs/data/access-ladder.md holds the dated terms check and the owner steps.

metrics._note: Where the admin reads each unlock number (K12 weekly marketing view). A metric with no reader yet is listed in docs/data/access-ladder.md.
metrics.monthly_users: cookieless weekly counters, summed over four weeks
metrics.affiliate_bookings: partner dashboard figures, entered by the owner
metrics.aviasales_coverage_pct: share of the 10,094 routes with a cached Aviasales fare, measured by the P1 coverage run
